- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods (high sentiment > 0.7) — reduce forecast peak by 5–10% if sentiment > 0.75.
- Underestimate prices after sharp spikes (e.g., >85) — add 2–5% buffer to prevent premature drop.
- Overshoot in early forecast horizon (1–7 days) — apply 10–15% downward adjustment if sentiment is neutral or negative.
- Mean-reversion bias in 14–30 day forecasts — reduce forecast by 3–8% if recent 7-day average is lower than 30-day average.
- Lagged sentiment effect: if sentiment drops below 0.4 in last 3 days, reduce forecast by 5–10% to reflect risk-off behavior.
- Avoid overconfidence in high sentiment + high price history — cap forecast at 10% above recent 7-day high if sentiment > 0.8.
